slides.texte_overlay:
5 words that will make
you sound more eloquent

Ardent:
very passionate
and enthusiastic
(AHR-dnt)

Example:
She was an ardent reader
of Russian novels.

Diligent:
careful and
hardworking
(DIL-i-juhnt)

Example:
She was diligent and
finished every chapter.

Debonair:
confident, stylish
and charming
(deb-uh-NAIR)

Example:
He walked in with a
debonair smile.

Felicity:
great happiness
(fuh-LIS-i-tee)

Example:
The quiet Sunday filled
her with felicity.

Sapient:
wise, with deep
knowledge
(SAY-pee-uhnt)

Example:
She grew more sapient
with every book she read.
